sn46.6:3.4: Given that this unique passage poses several linguistic difficulties, I have opted to translate it literally. | The text uses three synonyms: _citta_ (“mind”), _mānasa_ (“spirit”), and _cetasa_ (“heart”). | Read _apatitthīnacitto_ per BJT. It’s the same root as _thīna_, “sloth”. | “Undaunted spirit” (_adīnamanasa_) is also at [thag3.9:1.4]() and [thag15.1:11.4](). However, the texts waver between reading _adīna_ (“undaunted”) and _alīna_ (“not sluggish”; meaning established at [snp1.3:34.2]()).
